description: Cryptstalker Spaulders Level 60 Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Cryptstalker Spaulders if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Spaulders, 12 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 2 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Spaulders - Wartorn Chain Scrap x 12 - Arcanite Bar x 2 - Cured Rugged Hide x 3
name: Cryptstalker Spaulders
